name: Adam Schiff

issue_poll.name: PPIC Statewide Survey, Oct 7–15, 2024 (likely voters), with Emerson College California poll, Oct 12–14, 2024
issue_poll.note: Combined PPIC's most important issue for California (https://ppic.org/wp-content/uploads/crosstabs-likely-voters-1024.pdf) and for the U.S., plus Emerson's most important issue (https://emersoncollegepolling.com/october-2024-california-poll-harris-59-trump-35). Ranked by each issue's highest share in any of the three. Dropped 'government in general / elected officials'.

issues.position: $20 federal minimum wage; federal price-gouging rules
issues.note: Roll call per Congressional Record (govinfo, CREC-2025-04-04, S2350); no price-gouging vote held.

issues.position: Pass John Lewis VRAA; automatic and same-day voter registration
issues.note: The bills he backed and Court term limits got no floor vote.

issues.position: Expand the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit; incentivize faster local approvals
issues.note: H.R.1 permanently expanded the LIHTC; he opposed the package.

issues.position: More Border Patrol personnel and technology; path to citizenship
issues.note: H.R.1 funded Border Patrol hiring and technology; no citizenship-path vote held.

issues.position: At least $100 billion more federal homelessness funding
issues.note: No Senate floor vote on added homelessness funding found.

issues.position: Universal health care; expand Medicaid eligibility

votes.question: Cloture on the motion to proceed

issues.note: H.R.1 cut Medicaid and tightened eligibility. Vote 644 per Congressional Record (govinfo crec/171/s/8654).

issues.position: Free public college; expand Pell Grants; cancel student debt
issues.note: H.R.1 ended the SAVE repayment plan and capped student loans; it also added short-term Pell.

issues.position: More federal funding for police officers and community policing
issues.note: Package raised state and local police grants ($2B to $2.4B, per porac.org); vote from usquery.com.

issues.position: End oil and gas subsidies; point-of-sale EV tax credit
issues.note: H.R.1 ended the EV tax credits early.

issues.position: Middle-class tax cut; restore SALT deduction under $400K
issues.note: H.R.1 extended middle-class rates and raised the SALT cap; he also backed corporate tax hikes it lacked.

caveats: Five issues rest wholly or partly on H.R.1 under the package rule (housing, immigration, taxes counted against him; health care, climate, education for him). Each is a judgment call.
Crime rated on cloture for a three-bill spending package (likely roll call 10, unconfirmed). His Nay is read from an unlabeled list on usquery.com, and his passage vote was not confirmed.
ROAD to Housing Yea is inferred: he is not among the 10 nays or 1 non-voter on the Senate press gallery log for Mar 12, 2026.
Issue ranking mixes PPIC's California and U.S. most-important-problem questions with Emerson's; democracy ranks high only on the U.S. question.
